email_body:
Dear Smals team,

I'm writing to apply for the UX/UI Designer role. Your mission to create impactful digital solutions for society resonates with me, and I'd love to bring my mix of design and technical skills to your UX & Service Design team.

In my current work, I design and build websites end-to-end. I created baverok.com with a hand-coded landing page and WebGL hero, and built mirook.com with structured data and accessible markup. At Knowledge Experts, I designed SharePoint-based digital workplaces for large organisations like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, focusing on clear structure and user needs. I also have front-end experience (AngularJS, JavaScript) from ViviDoctor, which helps me turn designs into working interfaces.

I'm creative, detail-oriented, and collaborative, and I stay current with design trends and AI tools. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Smals.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Smals team,

I'm excited to apply for the UX/UI Designer position. Smals' focus on creating impactful digital solutions for society aligns with my own drive to build digital experiences that are both useful and well-crafted. With a background that blends design, front-end development, and digital strategy, I believe I can contribute meaningfully to your UX & Service Design team.

In my freelance work, I design and build websites from the ground up. For baverok.com, I created a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, ensuring accessible markup and a clear enquiry flow. For mirook.com, I designed a multi-page site with structured data and an intuitive layout. These projects taught me to balance visual identity with technical constraints and user needs. At Knowledge Experts, I supported the design and build of SharePoint-based digital workplaces for large organisations like ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff), where clarity and usability were paramount. My earlier role as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor gave me hands-on experience with AngularJS and JavaScript, which helps me communicate effectively with developers and turn prototypes into reality.

I bring creativity, attention to detail, and a collaborative spirit. I'm comfortable producing high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes, and I stay updated on design trends and technologies. I'm eager to participate in creative pitches and brainstorms, and to help Smals deliver engaging digital experiences that serve the community.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can benefit your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
